text: Okay, we have the procedure ready down here, and we will read it up to you one step at a time. Take your time, and tell us when you are ready to copy.
note: EP010 karakter sesi adaylari (2026-11-10). Yalnizca metin tarifi; gercek kisi sesi ya da kaydi referans alinmadi. Roller: capcom (yer kontrolu), cmp (kabin pilotu), cdr (komutan), lmp.

candidates.instruct: A calm American man in his late thirties with a clear, mid-pitched baritone voice, steady and unhurried, reading instructions aloud carefully, plain General American accent, matter-of-fact, no excitement.
A warm, fairly deep American male voice in his forties, gentle and precise, slow measured pace, the patient tone of a doctor explaining steps one at a time, quiet and even.
An American man in his late thirties with a lighter, slightly higher and slightly nasal tenor voice, tired and a little hoarse, speaking plainly and evenly at a brisk pace, low energy, understated.
A worn-out American man with a dry, slightly breathy mid-pitched voice, soft-spoken after days without sleep but tidy and matter-of-fact, relaxed pace, flat intonation.
A firm American man in his early forties with a deep, low chest voice, short and decisive, the calm authority of a commander, flat and economical, plain Midwestern accent, no drama.
A gruff, low baritone American male voice, clipped and dry, quiet confidence, speaks briefly and slowly, slightly rough texture, unhurried.
A younger American man in his mid thirties with a bright, light tenor voice and a mild Southern drawl, relaxed, casual and even, quiet, understated.
A young-sounding American man with a thin, clear, higher voice and a soft Southern accent, laconic, slightly slow, calm and plain.
